title: Croatian Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Croatia, featuring cod as the main ingredient.

ingredients.name: Cod
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: Croatian Broth
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with fish stock or make your own

ingredients.name: Nimble
ingredients.notes: Sliced or chopped, can be substituted with bell peppers

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the cod and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Croatian broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and add the nimble. Let it simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley or dill.
